a.lede: U.S. President Donald Trump says that he could pardon Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang if he finds himself in legal hot water over his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Huang is set to meet with the House Foreign Affairs Committee next week.
a.title: Trump says a pardon for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is 'always an option'

b.lede: Trump says he spoke to the board and that Huang "did nothing wrong."
b.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, board chair
